Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: unimplemented.

Trial scene extent is a geometric display region, not the temporal duration this ticket requests. TrialFixations and TrialPreview remain the relevant backend transport types, and the audit found no served trial-duration field feeding the inspector/timeline. Do not confuse visual TrialExtent with an admission/provenance-backed time extent. Add an explicit duration contract from eyes4s and regress the inspector text where the final fixation offset differs from the trial end.

Evidence:
- studio/viz/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/viz/trial/TrialScene.scala:228
- studio/core/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/core/backend/TrialViews.scala:169
- studio/core/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/core/backend/TrialViews.scala:243

Remaining / next action: Expose a native temporal extent and bind/test it in inspector and timeline.

Disposition: Keep open.
